title: End-of-flight final run specification (7 November 2026)
status: Production specification. Every treatment, prior and comparison rule used by a1gen_final.py and pool_final.py is listed here.

df.name: Davey model + fuel (main Results configuration, Pete's ruling 31 Oct)

wp.name: Waypoints (planned descent shown only here, Pete's ruling 3 Nov)

D9.label: Both timings + both frequencies as recorded

D14.label: Both timings + both frequencies, Holland start-up offset (zero floor)

comparison_rule: Log evidence is compared only between treatments of the same group (same data). Across groups the differences are not Bayes factors.

observations.BTO 00:19:29: 18,400 us, sd 63 us (Ashton Table 6; Davey Table 10.1)
observations.BTO 00:19:37: 18,380 us = 49,660 - 4 x 7,820 us (project derivation of Davey's correction), sd 43 us
observations.BFO sd: 4.32 Hz, same as the core (Pete's ruling 6 Nov); 7 Hz is a whole-chain sensitivity, not run here

priors.logon_cause_note: Fuel exhaustion vs other cause = 0.75 / 0.25 (q = 1/3, agreed 3.2 wording, 1 Nov). Sensitivity 0.5 (engine configuration value).
priors.logon_lag: Gamma(8, 14.875 s), mean 119 s (ATSB 3 Dec 2015: APU about 60 s + terminal about 60 s); sd 42 s has no source. Sensitivity: two-stage APU N(60,15) + terminal N(60,10) s.
priors.breakup_factor: Removed from all weights (Pete's ruling: break-up belongs to settling). Peak speed and load columns are kept for settling.
priors.piloted_pushover: Engine prior kept as headline (Pete's 11 Oct ruling: rate U[6,500, 40,000] ft/min, load-factor floor U[-1.0, 0.8] g, hold U[0, 300] s). Variant: load-factor floor re-weighted to the case-informed crew-active downward acceleration.
priors.lost_control_piloted: Headline excludes piloted paths whose remainder was flown by the withdrawn uncontrolled law (finite latent:free_dynamics_started_s); variant includes them.
priors.no_pilot_dive_kernel: Case-informed three-degree-of-freedom kernel (dive_kernel.py) for alternate-power no-pilot descents and for late steep endings of normal-power glides. Normal-power glides before a steep ending replay Boeing simulations with the pre-registered v2 spread (k 1.5).
priors.case_prior: case-prior.json: hierarchical lognormal fit (case_prior.py) of the 8-s downward acceleration, time from onset to 15,000 ft/min and onset delay; class 'no effective crew input'. Test A passed (pre-registered).
priors.kernel_evidence_ranges: kernel_params.py: pre-onset descent 1,165-1,465 ft/min; arrest bottom 3,751-18,895 ft; pull-out load factor 1.62-2.55 g (capped at the CS-25.337 limit 2.5 g); climb angle 1.8-57.7 deg; bank in the pull 37.7-51.8 deg (all from Boeing alternate-power simulations); bank at the end of the build-up U[35, 100] deg (Boeing 39-44 deg; Adam Air 574 90-100 deg); arrest probability Beta(5, 2) (Boeing 4/4 arrested, Adam Air 0/1).
priors.kernel_test_B: Passed 15/16 (pre-registered); peak descent before the arrest is high for Boeing simulations 4, 6 and 10 (PIT 0.004-0.083).
priors.thrust: Left engine about 55 kN until its flame-out (alternate configuration); approximate.
priors.importance_sampling: No-pilot alternate-configuration rows with power loss before 00:19:29: M = 16 replicates. T15 from the prior; onset delay from 0.15 prior + 0.85 uniform window placing 00:19:29 between 20 s before and 2 s after the 15,000 ft/min point; a8 given T15 from a mixture (0.4 truncated prior, 0.3 lognormal median 0.85 g, 0.3 lognormal median 1.3 g, log-sd 0.2). Exact weights prior/proposal/M with the truncation terms; checked: mean weight per row 0.998-1.003.
priors.other_family_code_6: Paths whose descent began before fuel exhaustion with no intervention (anticipatory or fuel-cue onset, family code 6) are flown by the withdrawn uncontrolled law. Headline: excluded with the other withdrawn-law paths. Variant 'include lost-control piloted paths' includes them and reports their share.
priors.kernel_fixes_after_review: Review 7 Nov (review/review-2026-11-07.md): stall limit (clean-wing CLmax 1.4 falling to 0.9 above Mach 0.8), start at or below the sea handled, arrest before the end of the build-up freezes the planned plateau, first sea crossing searched on a 10-s grid in the glide replay, no arrest for steep endings starting within 2,000 ft of the arrest bottom. Test B re-run after the fixes: 15/16 (unchanged).
priors.energy_caveat: No-pilot alternate-configuration dives reach about Mach 1.0 and 9.1-9.3 GJ (median), at or above the top of the Boeing range (6.4-9.0 GJ, maximum EAS 573-623 kt). Pre-onset peak descent in Test B is biased high (PIT 0.008-0.083 in three of four simulations). Energy and the 4 GJ label are declared sensitivities.
priors.prereg_deviation: The pre-registration text says 10 T15 values; the test used 11. The cause of the difference is not established, and Test A was not re-run with a 10-case subset. With 11 cases, 1 value is outside the central 95 %. The deviation is declared and stays open.

outcome_families.high_energy_dive: kinetic energy at impact >= 4 GJ (gap between Boeing normal 0.8-3.1 GJ and alternate 6.4-9.0 GJ)
outcome_families.note: Labels only; Pete's family table (574a4caf) is not yet ruled.

thinning: Russian roulette on the largest normalised weight over all treatments and variants; rows below epsilon are kept with probability w/epsilon and their weight is divided by that probability (unbiased).
flight_path_angle_convention: Hand-off: ground-relative flight-path angle at impact, positive in descent, from the kinetic energies (all rows one convention).
review: Independent review 7 Nov: verdict no-go with one blocker (kernel paths not reaching the sea) and six majors; all addressed or declared before production.
